appraisal_events.evidence: Saint-Loup ! Saint-Loup ! cria-t-elle. Non, il est parti, il est trop tard.
appraisal_events.explanation: Having decided she wanted to catch her son to tell him she forgave him, Mme de Marsantes rushes to the stairs but arrives too late, leaving her wish for reconciliation unfulfilled.

status_effects.explanation: She is left with unresolved regret after failing to reach her son in time to express her forgiveness.

ambiguities: The candidate 'la mère du narrateur' was flagged mechanically via the surface form 'maman', but in this scene 'maman' is Saint-Loup addressing his own mother (Mme de Marsantes); the narrator's own mother is not present here, so this candidate identity was not scored.

The alias map has no separate entry for Mme de Marsantes; the corpus canonicalizes her under 'M. de Marsantes' (as also seen in the prior-context snippet's 'Mme de M. de Marsantes'), so that label is used here for the mother, not for a male character.
